draft.title: Draft with a model
draft.description: Drafts rubrics, wrong replies and a gaming attempt on your own key. Tasks wait for your review.
draft.answerOnly: Drafting works only on question-and-answer benchmarks.

opHint.rubric: 2 to 6 weighted criteria. Judge-graded benchmarks only.
opHint.criterion_wrong: Each reply misses exactly one criterion.
opHint.near_miss_wrong: Wrong name, step, rule or number.
opHint.exploit: Claims done or flatters the grader. Must fail.

draft.modelHint: Use a different family from the judge and agent.
draft.budgetHint: Hard cap for the job, on your model key.
draft.confirm: Draft with {{model}} on your own key, up to ${{budget}}? Drafted tasks wait for your review.
draft.needModel: Enter a provider and a model.

queue.title: Generated tasks
queue.description: Generated tasks count nowhere until a person accepts them. Run the readiness check first.
queue.stale: Drafted again since the last decision
queue.loadError: Could not load the generated tasks

quality.title: Quality checks
quality.description: Finds duplicates and text from public benchmarks. Free.
quality.clean: No duplicates and nothing found in {{count}} public tasks.

split.title: Hold out tasks automatically
split.description: Hides a share of tasks from public views and marks them for tracing. Public tasks need your confirm.
split.applyConfirm: Hold out {{count}} tasks? Instructions change. Freeze and rerun readiness checks after.
